m: The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and opens the top door: outside is no airfield, only *grass* rolling into an *open sea* that never ends. It is **boundless**. He throws his hat as far as he can, and it just keeps flying. 'Where are the walls?' he squeaks, lost in the **boundless** green and blue.

The {Ghost} floats up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} with an *upward gaze*, staring at the *sun* through the skylight. It wants to fly, so it starts to **raise** its sheet, then its arms, then a whole aeroplane. It **raises** the plane above its head like a trophy and drifts toward the sun, glowing with pride.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Ice Rink} grows a bitter herb called *wormwood* in a flowerpot. Skaters smell it, scrunch their noses, and twirl away. The pot is labelled '**Xue** family secret'. Old Grandma **Xue** skates up, snatches it, and pirouettes off, sprinkling wormwood on the ice like confetti.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} into a pile of *hay*. Underneath is an old cow *hide* that has been soaking in the lake. As it dries, it **wrinkles** and **wrinkles** until it looks like a giant raisin, and the Jockey's own face crinkles up in sympathy.

The {King} on the {Rooftop} of the {Water Park} is a total *show-off*. He climbs the tallest slide and starts to **boast**: 'I'm the fastest! The bravest! The best swimmer in the world!' He leaps off, belly-flops with a SMACK, and floats up still **boasting** about his splash.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} onto the back of an *elephant* carrying an *offering* of bananas. Instead of guarding the exhibits, the elephant twirls, hums and lies in the fountain. Totally **carefree**! The Yogi joins in, and soon the mummies are dancing, **carefree** too.

The {Wizard} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and lands in a giant pink *stomach*, gurgling like a whirlpool. It swallows boats, ducks and his wand. He casts a spell, and the **stomach** burps him out across the water, his beard full of seaweed and his own **stomach** rumbling.

The {Sheriff} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut} and a huge pink *tongue* rolls down the steps like a carpet. It licks his boots, his badge and his moustache. He tries to lasso the **tongue**, but it curls round the rope and tastes it too. Every step is sticky with **tongue**.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} opens his *logbook*: 'Today: **peel** everything.' A *standing knife* hops up and begins **peeling** bananas, oranges, potatoes, then the fort's flag and the Baker's apron, all in long curling strips that float off the roof like streamers.

The {Ghost} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower}, where a *standing person* and a *wanderer* are arguing over who is grander. Both puff out their chests and refuse to bow. The Ghost tries to scare them, but they are too **proud** to notice. They stand nose to nose, the most **proud** pair in the tower.

The {Sheriff} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beehive}, where honey jars have tumbled everywhere. A *helping hand* follows him, **picking up** each jar and pressing on a *fitted lid* with a click. Click, click, click. It **picks up** the bees too, popping them into jars until the hive complains.

The {Wizard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} finds a dark *cave* where a dragon has built a **nest** inside a giant *wok*. The eggs sizzle gently. The Wizard sits in the **nest** to keep them warm, and three tiny dragons hatch and set fire to his beard.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} treehouse is fast asleep. Monkeys play *tug of war* with his eyelids, pulling them up and down, until his *eye* pops wide. He **opens his eyes** and screams: he is upside down above a crocodile. Every time he blinks, they make him **open his eyes** again.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} with a *carried bird* on each shoulder and a *helping hand* holding his lantern. He must **carry** a lunchbox to the yeti at the top. The yeti grabs him and **carries** everything back down: shepherd, birds, lunch and hand.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, which suddenly turns into a steep *hillside*. A gruelling *hill climb* later she reaches the top, where an ancient emperor's **tomb** sits under the floodlights. The referee counts to ten, but nobody gets up from the **tomb**.

The {Hunter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple opens his *mouth* to sing in the *shrine hall*, but a wild boar beats him to it. It **snorts** so loud the bells ring. The Hunter **snorts** back, and they keep snorting at each other until the monkeys cover their ears.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and taps a *tree* with his wand. Fluffy white **cotton** balls bloom on its branches. He spins them into *silk cloth* on the spot and pays the banker with fluffy **cotton** instead of coins. The banker sneezes.

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, where it has rained for a week and *moss* grows on the ropes. She waves her pom-poms, chanting 'Sun, sun, sun!' The *sun* bursts through the roof, and the sky is perfectly **clear**. The moss dries up and the crowd cheers a **clear** blue sky.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, where a *herald* is shaking a bag of *gold coins* instead of ringing the **bell**. 'That's not a bell!' she shouts. He melts the coins into a gleaming golden **bell**, and DING! the fight begins.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and spots a hole in the floor through her *magnifying glass*. She shovels *soil* in, but it vanishes. She **fills** it with buttons, thread, coins and a banker. It is finally **filled** when she sits on top of it.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive}, where the queen bee, the *boss*, orders him to **rear** her babies. He feeds them a *side dish* of pollen pancakes every hour. He **rears** a thousand fat, happy larvae, and they all call him Mum.

The {King} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Hut} gasping, tongue hanging out. He is **thirsty**. A few *water drops* fall from a leaky pipe, and each one bends into a *question mark*: 'More?' Yes! He slurps them all, but he is still so **thirsty** he licks the pipe.

The {Wizard} in the {Basement} of the {Funfair} spots a *pennant* with a painted *mouth* fluttering above the ghost train. It swoops down and gives him a big wet **kiss** on the nose! He blushes so red his hat catches fire, and every pennant in the fair blows him a **kiss**.

The {Baker} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a costume party. A *helping hand* grabs a *cut cake* and smears it on him as make-up. Now he is **dressed up** as a giant cream bun. Everyone else has **dressed up** as bakers, so he wins the prize.

The {Ninja} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and lands on a *road* where an *upside-down man* walks on his hands. Everyone else goes left; he goes right. The waves roll out instead of in. Everything here is **contrary**, so the Ninja sneaks backwards, the most **contrary** ninja ever.

The {Tsar} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and lands beside a *teetering man* holding a *moon* made of sugar glass. It is so **brittle** that it shatters when the Tsar sneezes. Shards tinkle everywhere. Even the chairs are **brittle** and snap like biscuits.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} runs from an angry swan. His *mouth* hangs open and he **pants** like a dog. A *sprout tip* pokes up from the floor and trips him. He lies there **panting**, while the swan steals his apron.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and throws a huge *fishing net* over the blinking *beacon* at the top. The light is **covered** and ships crash into the docks. He grins at his **cover**, then realises he's caught himself too.

The {Baker} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} shakes a cup of *fortune stick* bundles. One leaps out and points at the water. He uses it to **divine** the future: 'Splash coming!' A whale bursts out of the pool. He **divines** more and more, getting wetter each time.

The {Lifeguard} on the {Staircase} of the {Pool} lights a *campfire* behind a little iron *door*. It turns into a roaring **stove**, and soon the pool is a bubbling hot tub. She cooks sausages on the **stove** and hands them to the dripping swimmers.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Island} lighthouse and marks *this spot* with a cross. He chops the nearest *tree* into a huge pile of **firewood**. Then he cooks a feast so big that the pile of **firewood** burns all night and sailors see it from the sea.

The {Yogi} paddles a *dugout canoe* up the {Staircase} of the {Museum}, bumping over every step. Her *standing heart* bounces on the bow, beating with joy. She is so **pleased** that she waves at every painting she passes, and the paintings wave back, the stern portraits grinning, all equally **pleased**.

The {Sheriff} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} lookout and finds a busy *frog* weaving *silk thread* with its sticky tongue, braiding a long **rope**. Before he can draw his gun, it ties him up like a parcel, croaking. He wriggles free, grabs the **rope** and swings away through the trees, yodelling.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut builds a little *stage* under the *moon*. A shadowy **fetus** appears in a glowing bubble, curled up and sucking its thumb. She sews it a tiny blanket. The **fetus** kicks, and the moon wobbles.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} with sacks of *grass* for his *livestock*. He starts to **store up** hay behind every statue, ready for winter. Soon the whole museum is **stored up** to the ceiling, and the cows are visitors.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and waves his wand at a weary *commoner*. Her *eye* droops, then closes. She falls asleep standing up. He sends the whole bank to **sleep** too, and coins snore in their piles, deep in **sleep**.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} to a *podium* and juggles a hundred snowballs. She keeps going until every bit of energy is gone. A *question mark* forms over her head: 'Any left?' No. She is **exhausted**, and she has **exhausted** every snowball too.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house, and a hungry *spook* opens its *mouth* wide. He tries to **feed** it soup, but it passes straight through. So he **feeds** it ghost noodles instead, and the spook glows happily.

The {Sheriff} in the {Basement} of the {Spa} finds a *standing person* wearing cucumber slices as glasses and a towel as a cape. He insists he's a superhero. How **silly**! The Sheriff tries to arrest him, but he slips on a cucumber and looks even more **silly**.

The {Magician} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} onto a *heart cushion* floating under the *sunset*. A diver swims past doing perfect flips. The Magician sighs, eyes shining: he **admires** her so much. He hugs the cushion and **admires** every splash.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Casino} and finds an *army* of soldiers stomping through the fountain in muddy boots. The *water drops* turn brown and thick as soup. Soon the water is so **muddy** that the goldfish wear goggles, and every gambler leaves dripping and **muddy**.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} watches a *woman* hide coins inside socks on a *drying rack*. The socks look innocent, but they're stuffed with money. How **crafty**! The Juggler steals one, but the woman, even more **crafty**, has filled it with buttons.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion}, and a swinging *door* covered in *feathers* swishes back and forth like a giant **fan**. The wind blows his hat off and his moustache sideways. He fans himself with the **fan**, and the whole mansion cools down.

The {Gardener} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and lands next to a *tree* growing in very straight lines. She checks it with a *set square*: perfect right angles. It has grown into a **cupboard**! She opens the **cupboard** doors, and a dozen patients tumble out like laundry, holding their appointment cards.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} and lands in the lap of a *money changer*, who hands her a sack of coins for no reason. Her *standing heart* skips and dances. She is **delighted**! She skates in loops, flinging coins, and every skater catching one is **delighted** too.

The {Lifeguard} sprints up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} after a runaway vacuum cleaner gobbling the carpets. A *helping hand* leaps out and holds up an *orchid* in its path. She shouts '**Stop**!' The vacuum sniffs the flower, sighs, and **stops** dead, purring like a sleepy cat.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and follows a *stretching road* of balloons to a room where a *small speech bubble* pops: 'It's a boy!' A new prince has been born. She checks his first tooth to mark his **birth**, and everyone celebrates the **birth** with cake.

The {Baker} in the {Basement} of the {Tower} unwraps a *parcel* stuffed with every *side dish* in the world. He eats dumplings, noodles, buns, until he is so **full** he can't move. He rolls up the stairs, too **full** to walk.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} finds a *beggar* waiting at *dawn* with an empty bucket. No rain for months, and everything is **dry**: the plants, the soil, even the clouds. The Gardener weeps, but her tears are **dry** too.

The {Pirate} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} with a soapy *parcel* in his arms. *Water drops* splash on it, and out comes a gigantic **bubble**. It swallows him whole, and he floats up past every window, waving his sword inside the **bubble**.

The {Zookeeper} tiptoes up the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house and spots a **thief** in a stripy jumper stuffing a golden *shell* into his sack. A toy *soldier* marches out of the cupboard and blows a trumpet. The **thief** panics, falls in the lake, and the Zookeeper locks him in with the penguins.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} and finds a little *pavilion* with a curly roof built right in the middle of the ring. The boxers have stopped fighting to sip tea inside it. She sews silk curtains for the **pavilion**, and the referee declares the **pavilion** the winner.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut watches a pale *dusk moon* rise while the sun sinks into the sea. The sheep yawn. It is **evening**. The moon leans down and tucks each sheep in with a cloud, and the Shepherd counts them to sleep in the purple **evening** light.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} meets a hairy *father* who has been waiting *many moons* for his son to visit. Out pops a little yeti: 'Dad!' It leaps into his arms. The **dad** is so happy his teeth chatter, and the Dentist checks them. Best **dad** on the mountain.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} owes the fishermen of many little *islands* for his fish. To **repay** them, he rolls a giant *wine jug* down the steps into each boat. Glug, glug. Every fisherman is **repaid** with wine, and they sail home singing.

The {Robot} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and finds a *standing person* *waiting in rain*, reading a scroll under a tiny umbrella. He is a **Confucian scholar**, calm and polite, bowing to every raindrop. The Robot bows too, and the **Confucian scholar** teaches it proper manners until its joints rust.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} watches a *woman* roll out a *sleeping mat* for two. The groom arrives on a tandem bicycle. They are married on the mat, sealing their **marriage** with a pillow fight. The whole inn throws rice, and the Yogi blesses the **marriage** in a headstand.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} finds two *bamboo joints* rolling around like little logs. She taps one: it cracks open, and a fluffy cygnet tumbles out. Each *bamboo joint* is an **egg**! She puts the other **egg** under a swan, who looks very confused.

The {Firefighter} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} where a giant *cut cake* puffs *steam* like a chimney. The scent spreads over the rides, and the whole **atmosphere** turns sweet and cosy. People start to hug strangers. The Firefighter sprays the cake, but the **atmosphere** only gets warmer.

The {Shepherd} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} clutching an inflatable *globe*. It springs a hole, and *water drops* begin to **leak out** of Africa, then Asia, then the oceans. The yeti tries to plug it with its thumb, but the secrets **leak out** too.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} cuts down a tall *tree* and strips it into a long **pole**. She hangs a *drying rack* from it, loaded with socks. The **pole** wobbles in the wind, and socks rain down on the guests.

The {Ghost} on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} lighthouse wants a friend. A *helping hand* drags a deckchair **next to** it, and a *full stop* rolls up and sits down. They sit **next to** each other all night, watching ships, silent but cosy.

The {Sailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple finds a *standing person* in orange robes balancing a *steamer* of buns on his head. He is a **monk**, and he hums so deeply the trees vibrate. The Sailor shares a bun with the **monk**, and monkeys bow to them.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} hut and the *roof* starts to drip something golden. **Honey**! Bees have built a hive in the rafters. He pulls a rabbit from his hat, and it comes out covered in **honey**, buzzing.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Inn} and opens her *mouth* to **chant** in rhythm with a ticking *clock*. Tick, ohm, tick, ohm. Guests come out of their rooms to **chant** along, and soon the whole inn hums like a beehive.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} sees a *prowling dog* chase a falling *star* into the ring. A huge hairy **ape** catches the star and beats his chest. The dog runs, and the **ape** becomes champion of the ring.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} onto a *road* where a *trotting pig* races to the doctor's door. The pig dodges chairs, leaps over toddlers and bursts in first. It **succeeds**! The Sailor cheers as the pig waves a certificate saying '**Succeeded**'.

The {Shepherd} climbs a very **narrow** {Staircase} in the {Piazza}, so tight he has to turn sideways. A *prowling dog* squeezes behind him, and he pulls it through with a pair of *tongs*. The steps grow even more **narrow**, and they pop out at the top like toothpaste.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} and sees a *portrait* on the wall that looks just like him. Then a cat climbs into the frame and starts to **resemble** him too, beard and all. Soon every cat **resembles** the Shepherd and asks for a crook.

The {Tailor} on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} licks a gigantic stick of *candy* with her *tongue*. It is so **sweet** that her teeth tingle and she floats up the steps like a balloon. The bankers lick their coins, and they taste **sweet** too.

The {Shepherd} on the {Staircase} of the {Piazza} watches *rain* fall and borrows a paint pot with a *borrowed tool*: a long brush. He paints the sky pink and orange, creating **rosy clouds** above the square. The tourists gasp at the **rosy clouds** and ask him to paint their faces too.

The {Baker} on the {Staircase} of the {Fort} argues with a talking *horse* stuck behind a wooden *lattice*. 'Bread is boring!' says the horse. The Baker **refutes** it with a warm croissant. The horse tastes it and cannot **refute** a thing.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a lush *valley* where *shirt* trees grow. Shirts in every colour hang from every branch, more than anyone could wear. Truly **abundant**! She dresses the mummies, the statues and the guards in **abundant** shirts.

The {Wizard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and finds a single *yuan coin* glued to a *page* of his spellbook. He tugs, he zaps, he blows. The coin will not move. It is **stubborn**. He gives up, and the **stubborn** coin winks at him.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} of the {Museum} flies a *kite* inside a *square* glass case. Where is the kite? **In** the case. Where is the case? **At** the museum. The kite tugs, and the Yogi floats up **in** the air, **at** the very top of the stairs.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut reaches up into a coconut palm. A *helping hand* stretches out of a *dripping tap* to help him **pick** a coconut. Then another, and another, until he has **picked** the whole tree bare and the tap gurgles happily.

The {Ghost} in the {Basement} of the {Island} hut tries to shoot an *arrow*, but it only reaches the top of a *wilting stalk*. Everything down here is **short**: short candles, short chairs, a short Ghost too. It stands on tiptoe but is still too **short** to reach the light switch.

The {Magician} in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} holds a *grain stalk* and plucks off a tiny *pinch* of husk every **second**. Tick, pluck, tick, pluck. Twelve cats sit in a circle, tails flicking like clock hands, counting along. If he is late by one **second**, they all hiss and knock his hat off.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} peeks through a *mortise* in the wall and sees a **high official** in silk robes sitting on a throne. He waves a scroll and orders silence. She cheers anyway, and the **high official** joins the dance.

The {Chef} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and lands on a pig floating on a lilo. Cows paddle, goats dive, chickens sunbathe. The *livestock* has taken over the pool! He waves his cleaver, but the **livestock** splash him so hard he gives up and serves the **livestock** ice cream instead.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} onto a *sleeping mat* and opens her *mouth* wide. A giant dumpling falls from the ceiling. Gulp! She **swallows** it whole. Then she **swallows** the chandelier, the butler and the mat itself.

The {Pirate} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut is freezing. A *helping hand* grabs a bear *hide* and **drapes** it over his shoulders. He looks like a king. The hand **drapes** more over him until he is just a furry mountain with an eye patch.

The {Firefighter} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} wants to plant tomatoes. A *cart* rolls up loaded with a *seedbed* and helps her dig. It **assists** her every step, wheeling soil and watering seeds. Soon there's a garden, and the cart **assists** with the harvest too.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} dangles a golden *hook* over the edge, baited with roses. It **attracts** bees, then butterflies, then a duck, then a dreamy sailor who climbs up the rope. Everything that sees the hook is **attracted**, and soon the roof is crowded with admirers holding hands.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} and finds a *dish* with a *cut cake* that grows into a giant **basin**. Water fills it, and kids splash around in the **basin** while the Pirate floats on a slice of cake.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} draws a chalk line across the field: the *borderland*. On one side, home fans; on the other, away fans. She juggles across the **border**, and both sides chase her back and forth over the **border**.

The {Dentist} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} meets a *busy man* in dark glasses shuffling cards on a lilo. He bets a golden *shell*. She **gambles** her drill and loses. She **gambles** her chair, her mask and finally her own false teeth, and swims home toothless and grinning.

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} onto a pile of *soil* glowing under a *new moon*. He squeezes it, and it turns into shiny **plastic**: plastic boats, plastic ducks, a plastic whale. The pool fills with **plastic** toys.

The {Wizard} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and comes face to face with a *spook*. His knees knock. He **dreads** ghosts more than anything. The spook says 'Boo!' and he **dreads** it so much his beard turns white.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Tower} opens his *mouth* to complain, and a *pinch* of pepper flies in. ACHOO! The sneezes echo, shaking pots and pans. It's so **noisy** that the tower bells ring. Even the mice cover their ears at the **noisy** kitchen.

The {Ninja} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} dragging a gigantic **sack** behind her. Bump, bump, bump. Planes peek out curiously. She tips it over, and out pour smaller sacks, then even smaller ones, until the whole hangar is full of sacks. The last tiny **sack** holds a single peanut.

The {Ghost} sits on the {Front Step} of the {Funfair} and gives every visitor a *warm hug*. Each time, its round *mouth* hums, '**Mm-hmm**.' The visitors hum back, '**Mm-hmm**,' nodding. Soon the carousel, the clowns and the candyfloss stall are all nodding and humming together like one huge, contented fridge.

The {Pirate} on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} catches falling *water drops* in his hat until they spill over into a calm, glassy **lake** right on the roof. A *white dove* lands on it and floats like a swan. He launches a rowing boat to catch it and paddles round and round the tiny **lake**, getting nowhere.

The {Firefighter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and lands on a *moon* wearing an *apron*. She takes a deep breath, and her **lung** inflates like a balloon. She blows out the fire with one huge breath from her mighty **lung**.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse}, and his *horse* lands in a quiet *gathering* of ducks. **Sudden** chaos! Quacks, feathers and splashes explode everywhere. A **sudden** storm whips up from nowhere, the boats flip over, and the horse ends up rowing a canoe.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} with a spool of *silk thread* that **winds around** his legs. He trips into a *tangle*, and the thread **winds around** the banisters too, until the whole house looks like a spider's web.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} plants tulips along a long grassy *ridge* that runs like a dragon's back across the roof. Planes taxi underneath and scrape their tails on the **ridge**. Petals rain on the runway, and she plants a second **ridge** just to annoy the pilots.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} watches a *clown* try to kiss his *sheep*. The sheep blushes, hides its face in its wool and runs off. It is so **shy**! The clown is **shy** too and hides behind his red nose.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} beside a *climber* stuck halfway up a tree. He **glares** at her with one huge angry *eye*, as if it were her fault. She **glares** back over her mask. They stare and stare until the monkeys get bored, and even the tree looks away.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} and **hangs up** a gigantic *hanging lamp* shaped like a fish. Cats leap and swing on it. She **hangs up** more, and soon the whole café is full of swinging cats.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Piazza} finds a dusty *cabinet* full of golden *shell* coins, each stamped with the **surname Jia**. She juggles them, and every coin that lands spells J-I-A on the floor. An old shopkeeper bursts in: 'Those belong to the **surname Jia** family!' and demands his shells back.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and gets hit by *water drops* from a *leaky roof*. Drip, drip, splosh. The boats start to **leak** too, then the buckets she uses to bail them. Everything **leaks**, even her whistle, which now only gurgles.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} juggles *twin jades* while a parrot gives him a *tattoo*. Instead of a heart, it pecks a **spot**, then another, and another. Soon he is covered in **spots** like a leopard, and the jades are spotty too.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} drops a *longevity peach* into a bucket of *water drops*. The bucket boils, swells and launches a **big wave** that sweeps over the city. She surfs the **big wave** on her ironing board, stitching a sail as she goes.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} goes for a *leisurely stroll* around the chimney, her *heart* beating slow as a drum. Each step takes an hour. Her yawn is long and **drawn out**, her 'hellooooo' to the boats even more **drawn out**. By the time she finishes, it's next week.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and lands on the antlers of a *deer* doing backstroke. The **deer** gives her a ride across the water, antlers dripping. Soon a whole herd of **deer** is racing lengths and she has to blow her whistle at them.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and finds a *standing person* in armour guarding a tiny *hatchling* in a cage. 'This chick is our prisoner!' She grabs the guard instead, ties him up with a hose and **takes** him **prisoner**. The chick **takes** the guard's helmet **prisoner** too.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut melts *gold coins* in a pan, but they turn dull grey: **tin**. A *lizard* scurries up and taps it with its tail. It clinks like a cheap can. The Shepherd makes **tin** bells for all his sheep.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house waves a huge *fan* at the king's barge. He bows so **low** that his nose touches the tiles, then lower, until he is lying flat. The king says, 'Even **lower**!' and the Baker slides into the gutter.

The {Zookeeper} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} carrying a goldfish in a matchbox. He digs into the *grass* beside the runway to **bury** it gently. Pilots stand in a row with their caps off. A plane flies overhead in salute as he **buries** the little fish.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} with a hammer and chisel. He **engraves** the winner's name into a *name tag* made of *gold coins*, tap by tap. The champion lifts it, and the Magician **engraves** his own name on the back, just in case.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} pours *water drops* everywhere, and suddenly the roof is a sandy **beach**. A *caught bird* wriggles in her sewing net. She lets it go, and it lies down on the **beach** in sunglasses.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Piazza} into a wedding where a *woman* waits by a little *home* made of flowers. 'I'll **marry** you!' shouts the groom, juggling rings. She agrees to **marry** him if he catches all twelve, and he does, with his nose.

The {Tsar} on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} sees a *standing person* stuck halfway up a *lofty peak* of paperwork. He bellows through a megaphone to **urge** him on: 'Faster! Higher!' He **urges** so loudly that the papers blow away, and the man reaches the top by accident.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mint}, where a tiny *king* plays with a *spinning top* carved from green **jade**. It whirls so fast it hums. The Shepherd tries to catch it, but the **jade** top bounces off his head, leaving a perfect green bruise.

The {Chef} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and a *branch* breaks his fall. *Feathers* sprout from his back, then a **wing**, then another. He flaps up and down the hive, frying eggs mid-air, until one **wing** gets stuck in honey.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut} with a *dish* of leftovers. He places a *fitted lid* on top, and it snaps into a perfect **box**. Then he puts that **box** into a bigger box, and that into another, until he can't find his lunch.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and meets a *sweating man* in furs, roaring and swinging a club at a *bug*. He's a **barbarian**, and he smashes the vase, the mirror and the piano chasing it. The Magician pulls a rabbit from his hat, and the **barbarian** cuddles it, calm at last.

The {Yogi} in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut is about to start the lesson when a *full stop* rolls in and sits on her mat. 'Too late. It's **already** over,' it says. She checks: everyone has **already** gone home. She meditates alone, grumbling.

The {Pirate} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} kicks over a *slop bucket*. The slop slides down the walls and spells out the word **Pan**. Lady **Pan** storms out in her dressing gown: 'That's my family name, not your graffiti!'

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} hut, but halfway up the steps **diverge** like a tree *branch*. One goes left, one right. A *stop sign* stands in the middle. Her squad splits too, **diverging** into two teams cheering in opposite directions.

The {Tsar} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and **bestows** a golden *shell* on the queen bee. In return she **bestows** a *lizard* on him, wearing a crown of honey. He doesn't know what to do with it, so he bestows it on his butler.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower}, carrying a *parcel* that wriggles. He unwraps it: a slippery *fish* and a shiny **abalone**, clamped to the paper. He tries to prise off the **abalone**, but it suckers onto his nose instead.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} grows vegetables in a giant *wok*. She stirs *gold coins* into the soup for luck. The **wok** sizzles so loudly that pigeons dive in for a bath, and the **wok** spits coins across the roof.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} into a long **corridor** made of a *shed* stretched like chewing gum. A nervous *bridegroom* runs down it, searching for his bride. The **corridor** keeps getting longer, and he arrives on his wedding anniversary.

The {Chef} on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut wants a bigger kitchen. A *helping hand* grabs a *chipped axe* and starts to **tear down** the walls, the chimney, the door. Seagulls cheer. He **tears down** so much that he is left cooking on the bare sand.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swan Pond}, where a *heron* holds a watering can in its beak. It **pours** *water drops* over her head, then the swans, then the lilies. It **pours** so much that the pond overflows and she floats away.

The {Magician} in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} tries to lift a safe, but a *dodger* keeps slipping out of work. The Magician flexes his *strong arm*, straining, sweating, and **makes an effort**. The safe rises an inch. The dodger, ashamed, finally **makes an effort** too.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} with a blindfold over his *eye* and bumps into a *tombstone*. He's **blind** for a magic trick, but now he can't find the exit. Planes honk as he wanders the runway, **blind** and waving his wand.

The {Zookeeper} in the {Basement} of the {Island} hut sees a tomato under the *roof* shaking with fear next to a red *chili*. The farmer has come to **slaughter** the vegetables for soup. The chili jumps on the knife and **slaughters** nothing; it just sets the soup on fire.

The {Zookeeper} in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} hires an **assistant**: a *standing person* who only uses his *left* hand. He passes fish to the seals with his left, mops with his left, salutes with his left. His right hand just waves at nobody. Still, he is the best **assistant** the zoo has ever had.

The {Sheriff} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and peeks into a little *hut* where a giant *mouth* is sitting in a hot tub. '**What**?' he shouts. '**What**?' it shouts back, louder. They keep saying **what**, until the steam is so thick no one can see.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} as the *moon* starts **swelling**. A girl with *long hair* blows into it like a balloon, and it **swells** until it fills the entire hangar. Planes squeeze against the walls as the moon squeaks.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Hut} finds a *stop sign* blocking his kitchen. A *helping hand* **pulls** it, but it won't budge. He **pulls** too, and with a POP the sign comes loose, flinging him through the wall into the soup pot.

The {Shepherd} in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut builds a *small altar* covered in seashells and candles. Bells jingle, lanterns glow, and the sheep dance a conga line. It is pure **joy**! Even the crabs clap their claws, overflowing with **joy**.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} and spots a *swaddled baby* on a *road* far, far away. She runs, but it gets more and more **distant**. Cats wave from the window. Finally the baby waves back from the **distant** horizon.

The {Magician} in the {Basement} of the {Fort} has paint on his hands. A *helping hand* grabs a *treetop* like a brush and starts to **smear** the walls with green leaves. He **smears** the floor and the ceiling too, until the fort is a forest.

The {Tailor} in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} saws a long *bamboo* stalk into a hollow **tube** and drops a *matching cup* inside. She takes a deep breath and blows. FWOOMP! The cup shoots out like a cannonball, skims across the water and knocks a fish's hat off. The fish demands a **tube** of its own.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Staircase} of the {Beach} hut plays **chess** with a talking *tree*. The pieces are stored in a *winnowing basket*. Every time she moves, she does a high kick. The tree moves with its branches. They play **chess** until the tide comes in.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} wearing only a *shirt* and his crown. Everyone giggles. Red-faced, he swims to a *warehouse* across the water and finds a mountain of **trousers**. He pulls on fifty pairs at once, waddles back to the edge, and sinks like a stone in all his **trousers**.

The {Ghost} on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} lighthouse opens its *mouth* and lets out a long, sad **sigh**. A *full stop* falls out at the end. Then another **sigh**, and another full stop. The ships hear it and turn back.

The {Pirate} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} digs for treasure but finds only a *tree* and a *fortune stick* that reads: 'No gold for you.' Everything down here is **plain**: plain walls, plain rice, a plain wooden chest full of plain socks. He swaps his feathered hat for a **plain** cap and sulks.

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and sees a *cashier* with a giant *mouth* shouting orders. 'Put out the fire!' She is **instructed** to splash the flames. The cashier **instructs** her to splash harder, until the whole pool is empty.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Dunes} and finds a camel tied with a pink *ribbon*. Its tummy is huge: it is **pregnant**. A tiny *child* camel kicks inside. The Yogi helps the **pregnant** camel do breathing exercises in the sand.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive}, holds up a *snapped stick* like a sword and swears a solemn **vow**. A huge *speech bubble* floats from his lips: 'I will guard this honey forever!' Ten thousand bees stand to attention and take the **vow** too, saluting with their stingers.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} and meets a *marquis* in a powdered wig gargling seawater. His *mouth* opens so wide that the Hunter can see right down his **throat**, where a little fish is swimming laps. The marquis gargles, the fish surfs, and the **throat** gurgles like a drain.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and sees a *woman* dancing on a *tombstone* with a plane on her head. It's **absurd**! She tells him she's the queen of the moon. Every **absurd** claim makes the plane spin faster.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Museum} is juggling marble statues when she reads a *quotation* carved on the wall: 'Hands off the art.' A giant *helping hand* shoots out of the plaque to **restrain** her, pinning her arms to her sides. It **restrains** her until every statue is safely back on its plinth.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange}, and a *convoy* of trucks drives past, each linked by a **chain** of *gold coins*. The **chain** clinks so loudly that the banker comes out and wraps it around himself.

The {Chef} on the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} jumps on a *horse* as a *scorpion* waves its tail at him. They **speed** away so fast that the stairs blur and the bees can't catch them. They **speed** past the hive, the forest and the moon.
